            )

            "priority": int(row["priority"]),
            "done": bool(row["done"]),
        }

    def add(self, title: str, priority: int = 3) -> int:

            raise TypeError("title must be a string")

        conn = self._require_conn()

    def delete(self, todo_id: int) -> bool:

    def close(self) -> None:

            self._conn.close()
